List the slide layouts of a PowerPoint template

Source: R/report_officer.R
report_layouts.Rd

Shows what a template offers the report builders: every layout, its master, and the placeholders it carries. Useful to decide which layout to name in report_add_slide(), or to sanity-check an organisation template before building a deck against it.

Usage

report_layouts(template = NULL, style = c("elevated", "plain"))

Arguments

template

Path to a .pptx, an existing document from report_new(), or NULL (default) for the brand template registered by use_brand() (falling back to a built-in template, see style).

style

Built-in template to inspect when no template and no brand template are set: "elevated" (default) or "plain". See report_new().

Value

A tibble with one row per layout: layout, master, has_title, n_body, body_width, body_height (inches of the first body placeholder, NA when the layout has none).

Details

The report builders pick layouts automatically by inspecting placeholders, so most decks never need this – but when a corporate template offers several content layouts, report_layouts() plus an explicit report_add_slide(layout = ...) gives you full control. Requires the suggested officer package.

See also

report_new(), report_add_slide(), use_brand().

Other reporting: example_report(), list_report_templates(), report_add_plot(), report_add_slide(), report_add_table(), report_add_text(), report_deck(), report_new(), report_save(), report_section(), report_slide(), report_title_slide(), scaffold_report()

Examples

report_layouts()
#> # A tibble: 11 × 6
#>    layout                  master       has_title n_body body_width body_height
#>    <chr>                   <chr>        <lgl>      <int>      <dbl>       <dbl>
#>  1 Blank                   Office Theme FALSE          0      NA          NA   
#>  2 Comparison              Office Theme TRUE           4       5.64        0.9 
#>  3 Content with Caption    Office Theme TRUE           2       6.75        5.33
#>  4 Picture with Caption    Office Theme TRUE           1       4.3         4.17
#>  5 Section Header          Office Theme TRUE           1      11.5         1.64
#>  6 Title Only              Office Theme TRUE           0      NA          NA   
#>  7 Title Slide             Office Theme TRUE           0      NA          NA   
#>  8 Title and Content       Office Theme TRUE           1      11.5         4.76
#>  9 Title and Vertical Text Office Theme TRUE           1      11.5         4.76
#> 10 Two Content             Office Theme TRUE           2       5.67        4.76
#> 11 Vertical Title and Text Office Theme TRUE           1       8.46        6.36
